units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 25:31">Targ. Gen. XXV, 31</cite> (ed. Berl. <cite ref="B00769"><he>בְּכוֹ׳</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 7b:6">Ber. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>זבנה לבכירותֵיה</he> (not <he>זבניה</he>) he (Esaw) sold his birthright; <cite ref="Berakhot 7b:8">ib.</cite> <he>שקלו בכירותיה מיניה ויהביה ליוסף</he> Ms. M. (read <he>ויהבוה</he>; ed. incorr.) his (Reuben’s) birthright was taken from him and given to Joseph (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
<cite ref="Sotah 13a:8">Sot. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>נהי דזביני לבכירותי וכ׳</he> though I sold my birthright, have I ever sold my plain heir’s right?
